note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are written for this entry, in our own words, each citing its source.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. It is the last trophy by definition, so treat the roadmap as the guide: finish the story, clear the 100% checklist, and mop up the side quests and activities. Expect roughly 200 hours all in.

source.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing as Jason. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story trophies unlock as you play, so just follow the main missions until the chapter closes. Before it ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house — see Positive Mental Attitude, the one trophy that may be missable.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Nothing optional is needed for it; the chapter-closing mission triggers the trophy.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep playing the main missions; the trophy arrives with the chapter's final mission. Bank jobs unlock during this chapter, after the mission Credit Check.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The trophy pops when the chapter's last mission is complete. Bank vaults open late in the game, after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is...

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Once it is done you can keep exploring Leonida in free roam, so there is no rush to clean anything up first — the 100% checklist only appears after the story anyway.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks naturally as you play through the story; no side content is needed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Play the story until it appears and finish it — the trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Story-only; it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Just follow the main mission chain until it shows up.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Story-only; finish the mission and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Story-only; it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) only appears after the story, but everything you do before then already counts. It has 35 requirements: the story, 100 optional tasks, all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 vaults, 42 shooting-range gold medals, 300 stunts, and the collectible and scanning totals. Nothing on it is missable — it can all be finished in free roam. This is the longest trophy in the game, so treat it as the final grind before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind. Stunt jumps, driving under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count, and the in-game count tracks them under Progress. There are 397 stunts in total — 130 jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — so you only need 250 of them; the 100% checklist wants 300. Work through the stunt jumps first, since they are the easiest to find, then mop up bridge flights.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, the arcade, winning a race, and a stunt. You do not need to be good at any of them — just start each one once. Most unlock early; golf and the arcade open as you explore Vice City.

source.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges: 18 at the Griffin range and 24 at Rodgers Ranch. Each challenge has bronze, silver and gold score targets, and you need gold in every one. Use the range's own weapons, take the timed challenges slowly, and replay any challenge you miss gold on — replays are free and unlimited.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Each location hosts its own race; you only need one win per location, not every race in the game. Learn each course's corners, cut the racing line tight, and retry instantly after a crash — a win is a win.

source.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Street races, off-road races and the Top Fun drone races all have their own events; winning the same race twice does not add to the count. Pick the short, easy circuits first and work through the map's race icons one by one.

source.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take him on; pick the rod and bait the challenge suggests, keep the tension in the green while reeling, and land the bigger catch before the timer ends.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Walk into any arcade in Leonida, pick a cabinet, and play it through to its end screen. Any game counts, so choose the shortest one you can finish.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is Lucia-only and has 5 missions, opening from Chapter 3. Follow the strand's missions in order; the trophy pops when the last one ends.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is built around 7 shipwreck dives, opening in Chapter 1. Dive each wreck, collect what the strand asks for, and finish the last dive mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is 5 jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub. Finish all five and the trophy pops after the last job.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The strands include Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, plus the named quest lines — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret, Moses, Yasmani and Cal. You only need 8 strands in total, so finish the ones you enjoy and skip the rest.

source.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is 16 sports-car jobs — find the cars on his wish list and deliver them. The last delivery ends the strand and pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand runs through his synthetic labs; work through his jobs in order until the final one.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONLY TROPHY THAT MAY BE MISSABLE: the first meditation is Lucia's, on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth — guides report it may disappear once Chapter 1 ends, and whether it is required is unconfirmed. Do it the first morning you can. After that, meditate at every spot you find; a joint meditation counts twice, and the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, but the trophy needs all 18. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations.

source.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand has 15 Target Decks; the trophy is about taking down the one unique animal he marks for you. Follow his strand, track the animal with your hunting tools, and make the kill clean.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets scattered across Leonida; you need any 3 complete sets (the 100% checklist wants 15 of 18). Cards hide in shops, houses and landmarks — pick up every card you pass and check your sets under Progress, then Collections.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app on your phone. Walk up to a landmark, curiosity, sculpture or No Flusher tag, open WAiNK and scan it on foot; the game pops a prompt when one is nearby. The sets hold 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and 23 No Flusher Tags, so any 100 of them will do. Track progress under Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — races, stunts, activities and exploration goals — and there are 80 in total, so you can skip the 30 you like least. The 100% checklist wants 70 of them. Pick the quick ones first: short races, easy stunts and single-visit activities.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape. Get the police to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and hide until the wanted level clears — alleys, the subway and off-road trails help. Keep a fast car nearby for the getaway.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hold up three shops in a row while the wanted level stays active — keep your partner close, move fast between shops, and do not let the cops catch you between robberies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app as they drive past — parked cars, traffic, boats and aircraft all count toward the 100, while the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models. Scan everything new you see from the start and this pops naturally.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five of them before the meter runs out. Tight spaces with clustered enemies work best; save it for a shootout, not a duel.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City International Airport. Get to the airport and leave by an improvised route rather than a normal departure — a runway take-off in a plane is the most likely trigger. Guide writers are still pinning down the exact trigger, so if it does not pop on the first try, vary the exit.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Take on the Rhino tanks. The trophy is tied to the army's tanks themselves, so pick the fight on your terms — heavy weapons, sticky bombs and solid cover — rather than stumbling into one unarmed at a high wanted level.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, go in quiet, avoid the cameras and guards, and get out before the alarm trips. If you are spotted, leave and try again — only a clean run counts.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults sit in the 8 large banks and only open late in the game, after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is... (Wait at the Cafe). Each vault can hold up to about $205,000 and triggers a 4-star wanted level, so bring a fast bike and a planned escape route. Rob any 5 of the 8; the 100% checklist wants all 8.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find a truck on its route, stop it, take the cash, and lose the wanted level before the trophy counts. Block it with your car or blow a tyre, grab the money fast, and vanish down side streets.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named area on the map — Vice City, the Keys, the swamps, the farmland and the coast — until the map is fully revealed. Driving the highways between story missions fills most of it in; check the map for dark patches and drive through them.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs and 39 operations in total (all 39 are needed for 100%); for this trophy you only need one operation per gang. Operations show as yellow map icons — loot every key valuable at the site, then move on to the next gang's turf.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or spot overlooking Ocean Beach and order a drink with the view in front of you. Note: the exact trigger for this one is still unconfirmed by guide writers — if it does not pop, try different beachfront bars and times of day.

source.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description points to driving a car out through a showroom's front window. Note: the exact showroom and trigger are still unconfirmed — pick a showroom, get a car to the door, and drive out through the glass.

source.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. This is the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn: take its three key valuables — the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table, and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs) — then lose the police and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Raise both Jason's and Lucia's Strength to maximum — work out, fight and train with each character until both hit the cap. It is a slow grind, so fold gym visits into your regular play.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Almost everything you do — crimes, choices, good deeds and bad — moves the profile, and most players reach 500 without trying. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, then UI, to watch the count climb. Warning: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something — but the exact trigger is still unconfirmed by guide writers. Keep playing normally and check back as the community pins it down; do not grind blindly at it.

source.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida — but the exact encounter is still unconfirmed. Explore odd locations and keep an eye out for the unusual; this one will be solved by players poking at the map's mysteries.

source.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Note: the precise conditions are still unconfirmed — try a slow drive-by with a melee weapon ready and see if it registers.

source.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank jobs; you need the Dye Pack Jammer from the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check before you can fence them. Fence bills through your contacts until the $250,000 total is reached — bank vaults alone can hold up to $205,000 each, so a few big scores cover it.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, weapons, ammo and car mods — every shop purchase counts toward the total. It adds up fast if you kit out both characters and keep your cars upgraded.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garages to buy through the Vice City Real Estate app, for about $160,000 in total, after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Buy them all and the trophy pops — the garages also give you somewhere to store the cars you collect.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find cars on the street or in your collection, open the Scooter Bros app on your phone, and register them. Any 10 vehicles count, so register the first ten you drive.
